en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th‑ / early‑20th‑century brick complex behind a high wall and iron gate. The building has steep, slate-clad, mansard-like roofs with many small dormers and tall chimneys, suggesting institutional or official use (such as a school or government residence). A dirt road runs along the front with young trees planted by the sidewalk. The architecture is orderly and symmetrical, with tall rectangular windows and modest decorative brickwork.
